evidence.detail: Exact v308 enum constants are COMBAT, TELEPORT and UTILITY, proving a three-way magic-spell category domain.
Accepted R2 MagicSpellbookInterface stores and compares this enum while filtering individual spell entries by category.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 contains 41 spell constants including AIR_STRIKE, CONFUSE, WATER_STRIKE, FIRE_SURGE, HOME_TELEPORT and BOUNTY_TELEPORT.
Each enum value stores two ints plus MagicSpellCategory; constructor writes all three and a static lookup resolves a value by the first int.
Accepted MagicSpellbookInterface resolves widget entries through this enum, reads its category, and compares its second int against the player's magic level.

proposals.note: This is the individual spell enum used by the accepted spellbook interface; identity is direct rather than inferred from adjacency.
